On the dense, multi-seed network (300 rods, density 3.0, 12-sigma slab, 4 see...
nodes.statement: On the dense, multi-seed network (300 rods, density 3.0, 12-sigma slab, 4 seeds) the stress-relaxation time tau rises monotonically with collagen residence time -- 37.3 LJ at residence 12.5, 39.7 at 25, 43.1 at 50, 67.5 at 100, 101.6 at 200 -- reproducing the DIRECTION of Figure 2E across the full turnover range, while the elastic modulus stays turnover-independent (3.19 LJ). The relationship is an intrinsic relaxation floor (~37 LJ) at fast turnover plus a residence-dominated regime above residence ~50, not a single proportional slope. This resolves the 120-rod noise floor that had limited the earlier sweep to a single point (residence 100 -> 57.7 LJ).
